credits.title: Someone Special
credits.overview: A man and a woman, living just a floor apart, are battling personal traumas. They are brought together by a twist of fate, kindling an unexpected relationship.

credits.title: The Beast Below
credits.overview: An adventure comedy that follows a once-famous singer who returns to his hometown and takes part in a water field drilling contest, hoping to win a large cash prize. But what they do not realise is that a mysterious beast lurks underground.
